notes.title: Legend of Krannia version 0.1.8 updates
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, Krannians![/b][/h3]

We've already seen streamers who tried to play our game and we noticed one major issue: the current tutorial system is not effective and lacking.

We arrived to this conclusion since most people who streamed our game did not seem to apply the mechanics that has been shown in the beginning.

This does not mean the players are forgetful; this means that the current explanation of mechanics does not attract the player's attention. We also noticed that some core mechanics are not explained explicitly (players need to explore to find them out).

So, in this update, we tried to reworked the tutorial for Legend of Krannia.
The tutorials are now more interactive than the previous! We also tried to even out the tutorial to prevent cognitive overload.

With this update, we hope that players have more fun with experimenting with the different game mechanics of the game.

As always, we absolutely appreciate all the feedback that you have provided and please let us know if you encounter any issues in our discord channel.

Thank you for your continued support!

[list]
[*] [b]Mods[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked basic tutorial for movement, skills and stats
[*] Added tutorial for card rarity, deck setup, deck leveling, skill cancellations and reaction skills
[*] Changed description of life steal skills to reflect correct intervals
[/list][/list]

notes.title: Legend of Krannia version 0.1.7 updates
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, Krannians![/b][/h3]

Controller support is now available for Legend of Krannia!

We noticed that controller support is one of the most asked and requested feature for our game.

Although we wanted to add controller support for a long time, we needed to redesign our current UI to support keyboard and gamepad navigation (hence the update last week). We have also added control hints at the bottom part of the screen.

With this update, we feel that players will have more fun controlling Vahn and trying other builds!

As always, we absolutely appreciate all the feedback that you have provided and please let us know if you encounter any issues in our discord channel.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Legend of Krannia version 0.1.5 updates
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, Krannians![/b][/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252540/1a04a87b4db60bd341303fd0661ba2d7eea357af.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252540/1a04a87b4db60bd341303fd0661ba2d7eea357af.gif[/img][/url]

[b]This week is all about reaction skills![/b]

In our previous updates of the game, we increased Vahn's survivability by providing potions and adjusting several skills to prevent Vahn from being hit indefinitely. Although, the chance of being hit to death is now low, there are certain situations where this can still happen, especially when fighting a considerable number of enemies. We feel that there should be an option for the player to escape these situations.

Thus, we implemented reaction skills.

Vahn can now use reaction skills. Like active skills, reactive skill can be equipped by opening the album and dragging the corresponding skill in the combat skill area marked as "R". Vahn also now has a soul gauge and can be monitored in the upper left corner of the screen, just below the energy gauge.

Reaction skills can be used when Vahn is hit with a full soul gauge.
If Vahn is hit with a full soul gauge, Vahn may enter a reaction state for a limited time.
In the reaction state, time slows down and active skill is changed based on the reaction skills equipped.
Also in the reaction state, Vahn may opt to use his reaction skill or perform other actions like block or dash. If a reaction skill is used, full soul gauge will be consumed and only a quarter will be used if other actions were done. Performing an action immediately exits the reaction state.

Reaction skills varies from pushing enemies to massively increasing your dodge for a short amount of time. Feel free to experiment with your reaction skills.

With this update, players will now have enough utilities to battle large horde of enemies and enough survivability to battle end game bosses!

As always, we absolutely appreciate all the feedback that you have provided and please let us know if you encounter any issues in our discord channel.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Legend of Krannia version 0.1.3 updates
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, Krannians![/b][/h3]

Healing for everyo.., I mean healing for Vahn! LOL
This update features health and energy recovery for Vahn.

In the previous version of the game, when Vahn gets damaged, there's no other way to recover health aside from standing still. This may get boring and/or infuriating really fast (specially at higher levels since you have significantly higher health).

This also holds true when you run out of energy and you're mobbed by enemies. Chances of survival are slim to none since you cannot block or dash when you don't have energy.

In this version, we provided a couple of options to recover health and energy.

Vahn can now use tents and campfires across Logra. Using a tent or a campfire fully recovers Vahn's health and energy, along with restocking his potions. A tent card is required to use in a tent or a campfire to avail the perks mentioned. To acquire these tent cards, you can talk to guild members marked with a "T" or from Jack outside of Green Town. Only a maximum of four (4) tent cards can be carried at a time.

As for the potions, Vahn can regenerate both health and energy by pressing "Q" and "R" respectively. Note that the regeneration will happen overtime (not instantaneous). If no potions are left, you can visit any item shop or use a tent or a campfire to refill the said potions. Five (5) stacks of each potion is the limit as of the moment.

Finally, killing enemies now have a chance to drop health and/or enery orbs which recovers a percentage of Vahn's health or energy.

With this update, players will have less idle time for recovery, will have more options for survival, and more time to whack every single enemy in sight! We hope that this update increases the player's exploration time while maintaining the difficulty of the game.

As always, we absolutely appreciate all the feedback that you have provided and please let us know if you encounter any issues in our discord channel.

Thank you for your continued support!

[h3][b]Content and Features[/b][/h3]

[*] Added health and energy potions that Vahn can use to recover health and energy respectively
[*] Added a feature where killing monster has a chance of dropping health and energy orbs to recover Vahn's health and energy respectively
[*] Cutscenes can now be skipped by going to the menu by pressing "Esc" or by pressing the menu button
[*] Added Outskirts Dungeon for high level equipment farming
[*] Added Potion Tutorial in Message boards in Green Town and Green Town Guild Hall
[/list]

[*] Most skill can now push or pull the target, preventing the target from being hit indefinitely

[*] Reduces the number of enemies during Brent's final encounter
[*] Reduces Accuracy per Coordination from 2 to 1
[*] Reduces Dodge per Coordination from 2 to 1
[*] Slightly reduce endurance growth of crocodile to reduce skill spamming
[/list]

[*] Fixes an issue where Vahn's ear is appearing over the headgear when equipping certain armor cards

[*] Fixes an issue where Bosses unexpected scales down to the Vahn's level

[*] Fixes an issue where using energy potions increases Vahn's energy above his maximum energy
[*] Fixes an issue Gilbert conversion in Luxxe city road getting triggered repeatedly
[*] Fixes an issue with spear weapons not being affixed to Vahn's hand
[/list]
[h3][b]Graphic[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Legend of Krannia version 0.1.2 updates
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hello Krannians![/h3][/b]
First of all, we want to thank you for all the feedback you provided during the first week of our release.
After collating all the feedback, two big issues seems to standout: The game being too difficult and the game features/mechanics not being explained properly.
We've come up of both short term and long term solution to tackle these issues.
This update focuses on the short term solution (please see details below).
We appreciate all the feedback that you provided. Keep them coming!
Also, please let us know if you encounter any issues in our discord channel.

[h3][b]Content and Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the current level of the player/enemies above the health bar
[*] Added !/? on quest boards (repeatable and helpful hints)
[*] Added additional tutorial (deck, stats, skills, upgrades) on dialogue and on helpful hint board
[*] Added additional low-level quest after joining the guild for +exp and equipment
[*] Added additional stat on the shield equipment
[/list]
[h3][b]Mods[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Quest re-balanced, (decreased kill count to complete, increased level cap on getting quests)
[*] Increased the base damage of all primary weapon equipment
[*] Monsters on low level areas no longer attack on sight
[*] Adjusted spawn rate of monster on low level areas
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue where drop (white glowing orb) is not visible when an enemy is killed
[*] Fixes an issue where multiple passive skill of the same type is being equipped in the deck
[*] Fixes an issue where reactive skills are being equipped in the passive slot area
[*] Fixes an issue where graphic/sound settings are not being applied when starting the game
[*] Fixes a wall glitch when entering from Luxxe City Road to the Bandit Camp
[*] Fixed an issue about monsters not scaling to the correct level
[/list]
[h3][b]Graphic[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced visual effect on skills
[/list]
